messages.content: Extract the order from the message. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else. Use exactly these fields: order_id (integer), customer (string), item (one of "M6 bolts", "M8 bolts", "M6 nuts"), boxes (integer), price_per_box (number), ship_date (string, YYYY-MM-DD).
Hi, this is Lindqvist Tools. Please book order 4471: three boxes of M6 bolts at 4.20 dollars per box. We need them shipped on 2026-11-03. Thanks!
